description: Whether a named land use is permitted, conditional or prohibited in a covered jurisdiction's published zoning table, with the exact table row and page citation. Unsure answers are UNKNOWN and a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged. $0.15 per call in USDC. Verified: 100% golden accuracy (64/64), 100% page-cited, a fully UNKNOWN answer is never charged, 100% uptime (24h). Per-jurisdiction data dates: see check_coverage.
